risks.risk: The iron does not heat or the thermostat has failed.
risks.proof: A short clip of the iron plugged in, indicator light on, then pressing a damp cloth until it steams or a water drop sizzles on the soleplate.

risks.risk: Spliced cord with exposed wire is an electric shock and fire hazard and needs replacing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the whole cord, both splices and the opened plug.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a new cord and plug

risks.risk: Soleplate scratched, burnt or rusted, which marks clothes.
risks.proof: A flat photo of the soleplate in daylight.

risks.risk: Brand unknown, so it may be a low-end no-name iron.
risks.proof: A photo of the rating label under the heel or on the side of the body.

proof_requests: A short clip of the iron plugged in and heating, light on, pressing a cloth.
Close-ups of the cord splices and the plug.
A photo of the rating label with brand and wattage.
response.reason: It is clearly a used dry pressing iron, identified by type, so it can be priced at its worst case: not working, with a damaged cord. The photo contradicts 'like new' and 'never repaired', so those claims add nothing to the quote.
